sections.Profile:
Paradise and Pleasure Isle , both released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1965, are sister electro-mechanical pinball machines designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Roy Parker. Paradise is the replay version, while Pleasure Isle is the add-a-ball variant.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1965–1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: America, Hawaii, United States, Two player, Dancing, Original Theme
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Roy Parker
- Animation: Ed Krynski
- Design: Ed Krynski
